title: Album Cover with Reclining Male Figure
coreRelationships: The subject's gaze is directed forward, engaging the viewer.
The soft, warm lighting emphasizes the subject's features and creates a relaxed mood.
The sepia tone unifies the image and gives it a vintage aesthetic.
The typography is integrated into the upper right, complementing the subject's pose without obscuring his face.
reuseFormula: Recreate a sepia-toned, soft-lit portrait of a reclining figure, ensuring ample space in the upper right for two lines of custom-lettered text. The primary text should be a bold, calligraphic sans-serif in a warm off-white with a subtle shadow, and the secondary text a delicate, flowing script in a cool accent color. Maintain a vintage, intimate aesthetic.
